prompt: A rotting zombie gravedigger with greenish-grey decaying flesh and tattered burial clothes, hunched in a low crouch inside an open grave, hauling a limp pale corpse up out of the dark soil by its arms. The corpse has greyish, drained, but still human flesh, contrasting sharply with the green zombie. A rusted iron shovel is stabbed into the mound of dirt beside the grave. The background is a moonlit graveyard with crooked headstones and bare trees under a deep blue night sky.

Wide shot of a vast moonlit cemetery at midnight. A lone rotting zombie with green-grey decayed skin stands waist-deep in a freshly dug grave, lifting a pale drained human corpse out of the earth toward the silver moon. Rows of crooked weathered headstones and a wrought-iron fence recede into the misty distance. The only source of light is the full moon haloing the figures. Deep indigo night sky.

Close-up, worms-eye view from inside an open grave looking up. A rotting zombie gravedigger with greenish decaying face and exposed teeth leans down into frame, both grey-green hands reaching toward the viewer to drag them up out of the dirt. Loose soil and pale gnarled tree roots frame the edges. Torn shroud cloth hangs from his arms. The background above him is a sliver of pale moon and dark night sky.

Two figures, both fully visible, in a moonlit graveyard. A standing rotting zombie with green-grey decaying flesh and tattered clothes hauls a limp dead human body up out of an open grave by both wrists. The dead body has greyish, drained, but still human flesh, head lolling back, both bare feet dragging through the dirt, clearly a different pale colour from the green zombie. A rusted shovel leans on the dirt mound. The background is crooked headstones and bare trees under a full moon in a dark blue sky.

A rotting zombie gravedigger with green-grey decaying flesh shown in side profile facing south-west, mid-heave, dragging a pale drained human corpse out of a black grave pit by its arms. The corpse droops, head lolling back, one pale arm dangling, contrasting against the green zombie. Mounds of freshly turned dark earth and a rusted iron shovel in the foreground. The background is a moonlit cemetery with leaning headstones and a wrought-iron gate, deep navy night sky.

A hulking rotting zombie with green-grey decayed flesh and a torn burial shroud stands gripping a rusted iron shovel, having just dug open a grave at his feet. A pale drained human corpse is half-risen from the open coffin, its greyish but still human flesh and lolling head clearly different from the green zombie. Loose dark soil heaped around the pit. The background is a moonlit graveyard with crooked headstones, bare branches, a full moon in a deep blue sky.

A rotting green-grey zombie stands over an open grave, holding a limp pale dead human up high by the chest, the corpse hanging slack with arms and bare feet dangling, head lolling back. The dead human has greyish, drained, but still human flesh, a stark pale contrast to the green zombie. A rusted shovel is stuck upright in the dirt mound. The background is a moonlit cemetery of crooked headstones and skeletal trees under a full moon, deep blue night.

Low close view of a rotting zombie kneeling at the edge of an open grave, both green-grey hands clutching the wrists of a pale dead human he is dragging up out of the black pit. The corpse fills the foreground, greyish drained but still human flesh, head tipped back, one bare arm hanging limp, clearly different from the green zombie. Heaped dark soil and a rusted shovel blade. The background is a low moonlit headstone and dark night sky.

A gaunt rotting zombie with green-grey decaying flesh and a tattered shroud, lit only by a single lantern hooked on a headstone, hauls a pale drained human corpse up out of a freshly dug grave. The lantern is the only source of light, its warm amber glow catching the green zombie and the pale grey body, which has lolling head and dangling limbs. Mounds of dark earth and a rusted shovel. The background is a black graveyard of leaning headstones fading into night.
